reviews.title: Parts arrived broken
reviews.comment: I installed the cooler in my pc and the display worked but the radiator fan and cooler didn’t work. I took it to a computer repair store and they let me know the power cable to the fan’s are broken and need to be replaced. I couldn’t find a replacement for the cable so I had to return it.
reviews.author: JayB

reviews.title: Good AIO, exceptional display
reviews.comment: This worked well and looks great.  I ended up switching to a 420 liquid freezer for my system though because it was working a little too hard in my Ryzen 9 system since my office does not have central air.  You do need to commit to running the software (windows only) and it will revert to the default logo images when windows is not actively running the program.  This looks good while you are using your computer, but expect it to show just the default images if your computer is hibernating or you the software is not running in the background.  Overall, I had no issues with the software though.  I enjoyed the "capture" feature which allows you to basically create any 30 sec video you want for looping.  I had a lightning dragon in flight and my son is currently showing a black hole image on his that looks amazing.  For me the temps were a little off from what my MB said, but that just may be different sensor readings.  Is it overpriced, probably.  But it will instantly make your system look high-end and the fans are honestly pretty good quality.
reviews.author: Ryan's Mom

reviews.title: Great buy and great product
reviews.comment: Building my first PC, I wanted a cooler that offered both performance and style, and the TRYX Panorama 360 did not disappoint. The packaging was impressive, and the cooler itself has a premium look that instantly adds a polished touch to my setup. I was worried about the installation process since I’m new to building, but it turned out to be much easier than I expected. The instructions were straightforward, and I got it installed without any issues. It fits well in my case, and the quality feels top-notch. Performance-wise, this cooler keeps my Ryzen 5800X3D running comfortably cool, with idle temps staying in the low 30s. Even during intense gaming sessions, it barely reaches the mid-60s. I also appreciate how quiet it runs—I hardly notice the fans. The standout feature is definitely the OLED screen. The display quality is sharp, and the L-shaped design gives my build a unique and modern look. I included a video to show just how detailed the panoramic screen is with the default software graphics—it’s very clean and adds a whole new level of customization to the setup. Pros: - Sleek design with a stunning OLED display - Great cooling performance for gaming and everyday use - Runs quietly, even under load - Installation-friendly for beginners - High-quality construction Cons: - It's a bit expensive, but the features and quality justify the cost - After using this, I don’t think I could go back to a basic cooler For my first build, this AIO was definitely the right choice, and I'd recommend it to anyone looking to step up their cooling game.
reviews.author: Quinn L.

reviews.title: GOAT AIO!
reviews.comment: I've built many PCs over the years, and I doubt another AIO will top this one anytime soon. TRYX nailed the details, from the packaging and cooler design to the ease of installation. The AIO looks premium, and the build quality is outstanding. This CPU cooler is perfect for gamers and professionals who need top-notch reliability, performance, and cooling. I'm running a Ryzen 5900x, and the CPU stays in the low 30s on idle, and rarely exceeds the high 60s under gaming load. It runs cool and quiet so you can focus on work or play without distraction. What sets this AIO apart is its crystal-clear Panorama OLED display. It's the best-looking AIO on the market, featuring a large L-shaped OLED screen that plays custom videos in high resolution and frame rates. The TRYX Kanali software makes managing the display/fans simple and intuitive. Pros: • Best looking AIO and Display technology • Excellent cooling performance, especially under load. • Quiet operation, even with multiple fans running. • Premium build quality and reliable pump performance. • Easy to install, even for first-time builders. • Compatible with a variety of CPU platforms. Cons: • High end product with matching price point, but it’s worth the money. • Will be difficult to go back to another CPU cooler after using this one.
reviews.author: Ethan

reviews.title: 4.75 Stars.  Amazing pump & Screen
reviews.comment: This is amazing looking, and that it would be worth 5stars.  However the high pitched whine of the pump fan causes it to lose a star.  I wish I could give it a 4.75.  I've tried multiple ways to silence the fan, but high pitched noise is present.  Its not loud, and you get used to it, but I feel a slight bump in fan size, or perhaps a different style of bearing could do a lot to silence the whine.  Again, its not bad, but is keeping this from getting a perfect score.  The entire kit is built VERY well, and of a very High quality.  Their software is minimal, easy to use, and works great.  OLED is bright and looks awesome. If you are not sitting right next to your case, you probably wont hear the pump fan.  And again its not bad, but present.
